text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali on Wednesday chaired a cabinet meeting that discussed a draft for a new tax procedures code.
- Tunisia on Wednesday sent aid to Iran quake victims.
- Tunisian businessmen visited last week Morocco and held talks with their counterpart on reinforcing bilateral cooperation in economic fields.
- Polish parliament speaker Josef Zych on Thursday starts a three-day visit to Tunisia.

- Tunisian archeologists found remains of commodities cargoes from the Phoenician and Roman periods in the Mediterranean, showing the importance of wheat, olive oil, wine and fishes trade during these periods.
- The draft of tax code project would give more gaurantees to taxpayers.
